title: Praner Cheye Priyo
desc: A couple's life falls to ruin when Chaiti, a sinister woman, marries into their family and wreaks havoc among them.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.

title: Deewana
desc: A newlywed Kajal gets widowed when her husband, Ravi, is killed by his enemies. She moves to another city and gets married to Raja, but her life takes a turn when Ravi returns from the dead.

title: Abhimaan
desc: After disowning his daughter years ago, an elderly businessman now seeks the help of his grandson to mend his relationship with her.

title: Projapati
desc: A 65-year-old retired widower, living alone with his son Joy, hopes he will marry to ease his loneliness. However, Joy, a busy wedding planner, has no plans to settle down anytime soon.
